quantitative_budget.optimizer: When both norms are nonzero, R_*=[sqrt(pi)||G'||_2/(2||G||_1)]^(2/3).
quantitative_budget.vector_extension: The same estimates hold for finite-dimensional vector values with Euclidean norm by vector Plancherel and Cauchy-Schwarz.
quantitative_budget.use: The bound is an explicit conditional budget for zero-limit holonomy amplitude.
quantitative_budget.scope_guard: The budget does not control electric-field L1, curvature, differentiated current, radial remainders, nonlinear scattering, a physical domain, or a source-owned representation.
